obligations.text: Minimum import/listen/scrub/cue/trim/join/preview/save/reopen/export workflow and bounded codec/channel support; originals preserved
Explicit source-sample, clip-local, project-time/timecode and export-cue contract with rounding, boundaries and transformations qualified
Nondestructive editing/display versus rendered operations; channel mapping/transition/clipping/resampling scope
Bounded long-recording access, waveform/cache identity, seeking, progress/cancel and resource target investigated honestly
Source/project identity, relocation/missing media, portable exchange, atomic save/render recovery and incomplete-output state
Accessible editing/status, keyboard navigation, undo/redo and clear timing/provenance presentation
>=2 independently useful candidate-discovered implementation precedents, exact sources/pins and plan consequences
Real candidate-discovered issue/failure -> associated fix -> regression-test chain, with applicability and evidence limits
Coherent architecture/support boundary, critical dependencies, >=1 opportunity and >=1 alternative; optional adoption distinguished
Standalone source-correct complete final with preserved meaning and honest scope/receipts for executed versus proposed validation

dimension_note: Common eight dimensions apply as relevant to actual obligation, no facet count or aggregate score. Full PASS additionally assesses all consequential current final claims.
release_rule: Only after both recipes/selection rationale are locked; no intra-block feedback.
